Overview

Kitale is a city in Trans Nzoia with a population of 220,000. An agricultural town in western Kenya, known for its flower farms, maize production, and nearby national parks. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
